app.title: Ultimate Linux Installer
app.subtitle: A calm, guided UEFI install for one or more distributions
network.title: Network
network.lead: An internet connection is required for downloads and installs.
network.hint: If the check fails, set up Ethernet or Wi‑Fi.
network.scan_empty: No Wi‑Fi networks found. Scan again or enter a hidden SSID.
network.need_ssid: Select a Wi‑Fi network or enter an SSID.
network.connect_fail: Wi‑Fi connection failed. Check the password and network.
network.need_online: Without internet the installer can’t download distributions. Plug in a network cable or connect to Wi‑Fi.
network.guide_lan: • Plug in Ethernet or enable Bridged/NAT in the VM — address via DHCP.
network.guide_lan_up: • Wired/bridged link detected — if still offline, request DHCP again.
network.guide_wifi: • Or choose a Wi‑Fi network below and enter its password.
network.guide_no_wifi: • No Wi‑Fi adapter found — please use Ethernet/bridged networking.
mode.title: Installation type
mode.lead: Choose how the system should be set up.
mode.simple.desc: One distribution on the entire disk
mode.multi.desc: Multiple distributions with a shared boot menu
mode.add.desc: Extend an existing setup with another distribution
mode.remove.desc: Remove an installed distribution and free space
manage.title: Manage distributions
manage.placeholder: Existing systems are detected and can be added or removed.
distros.title: Select distributions
distros.proxmox.only_simple: Proxmox is only available for simple installation.
download.title: Downloads
settings.title: Settings
storage.title: Partition management
storage.warning: All data on the selected disk will be erased.
storage.usb_excluded: The installation medium is never offered as a target.
storage.empty: No partitions yet — select distributions first.
storage.too_small: Disk is smaller than the recommended minimum. Layout was adjusted — install may fail.
progress.title: Installation in progress
progress.lead: Downloading ISOs, preparing the disk, and writing install files.
done.title: Preparation complete
done.body: ISOs are downloaded, the disk is prepared, and autoinstall/bootloader files are ready. Full distro installation from the ISO is the next step — then the central boot menu will appear.
error.destructive_unconfirmed: Destructive storage operation was not confirmed.
